headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with AI driving upside for several firms.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from modest double‑digit to high‑50% year‑on‑year. AI‑related revenue and deal wins were highlighted by Infosys, LTM, HCLTech, Mphasis and TCS. Margin guidance was raised by Coforge and Mphasis, while Infosys trimmed its FY27 outlook. Profit growth was strong at HCLTech and Mphasis but slipped at Infosys and Wipro.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: AI contributed 10%+ of total revenue at TCS and drove double‑digit growth at Infosys, LTM, HCLTech and Mphasis.

themes.title: Margin guidance changes
themes.detail: Coforge and Mphasis raised FY27 EBIT margin guidance, reflecting confidence in higher‑margin AI services.

themes.title: Dividend payouts
themes.detail: Most peers declared or increased interim dividends, signaling cash generation strength.
